title: Initial review of the design services contract
scope: This document is an example exercise only and is not legal advice.
overview: This contract has a few points the two parties need to clarify; we suggest discussing delivery and payment first.

issues.quote: The Designer shall provide several design drafts and the necessary source files
issues.risk: There is no concrete list of the several drafts and necessary files, so the parties may understand the scope of delivery differently.
issues.suggestion: The parties should add a list of design drafts and source files and attach it to the contract once confirmed.

issues.quote: the balance is paid promptly after the project ends
issues.risk: Neither the end of the project nor promptly is objectively defined, which may leave the final payment unsettled for a long time.
issues.suggestion: Define how the end of the project is determined and set a deadline for the final payment.
